scope: Paired, partially paired, bridge, sample-factor and anchor boundary methods; 17 selected primary papers, not exhaustive.
openalex_discovery: Parent-coordinated OpenAlex discovery; raw/openalex_01.json and subsequent query files. These are supplementary primary-source checks.
interpretation_note: Theorem applicability and positive restrictions are reviewer synthesis, not attributed universal impossibility claims by the original authors.

records.title: Comprehensive Integration of Single-Cell Data
records.training_information: Corresponding features, CCA/PCA and mutual-neighbor anchors. RNA/ATAC alignment uses gene-level accessibility summaries; reference-label transfer additionally uses reference labels. Protein transfer uses a CITE-seq reference with paired RNA/protein.
records.target: Dataset harmonization, cell-state annotation and transfer of measured features.
records.theorem_applicability: Mode-dependent: strictly disjoint anchor construction with only allowed feature mappings is covered; paired-reference feature transfer has additional joint information and is outside that contract.
records.positive_restrictions: Representative shared features and transferable reference neighborhoods support alignment/prediction; they do not identify arbitrary residual copulas.
records.evidence_locator: STAR Methods: dimensional reduction, anchor identification, data integration and label transfer; Results protein imputation.
records.caveat: Anchor pairs are inferred correspondences, not necessarily the same cell. Treat reference-assisted modes separately.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: Integrated analysis of multimodal single-cell data
records.training_information: Multiple modalities measured in the same cells. Within- and cross-modality neighbor prediction learns cell-specific modality weights; no cell-type labels are needed for those weights.
records.target: Joint cell representation, clustering, visualization and state definition.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside strict-disjoint setting in its native form: same-cell correspondence is an input.
records.positive_restrictions: Paired measurements provide joint observational evidence; downstream causal orientation still needs separate assumptions.
records.evidence_locator: STAR Methods: Weighted Nearest Neighbor Analysis; within/across-modality prediction and cell-specific weights.
records.caveat: A WNN cell-neighbor graph is not a regulatory graph. Unimodal query mapping uses an already constructed reference.

records.title: Dictionary learning for integrative, multimodal and scalable single-cell analysis
records.training_information: An additional multiomic dataset measures both modalities in the same cells. Its cells become dictionary atoms; unimodal datasets are reconstructed in those shared coordinates. Annotated references support label transfer.
records.target: Cross-modality reference mapping and scalable integration, including histone and methylation queries.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside strict-disjoint information contract: the paired bridge supplies cross-view information.
records.positive_restrictions: Coverage of relevant states and transferability between bridge/reference/query populations are needed for successful mapping.
records.evidence_locator: Publisher abstract; indexed primary Results and Figure 1 workflow. Supplemental mathematical methods not inspected.
records.caveat: Publication online in 2023, issue year 2024. PMC author title includes 'massively'. Publisher/PMC full-text access failed; source excerpts verify bridge requirement.

records.title: Single-Cell Multi-omic Integration Compares and Contrasts Features of Brain Cell Identity
records.training_information: Unpaired datasets on corresponding gene-level features. Integrative nonnegative factorization learns shared and dataset-specific metagenes; factor-neighborhood construction and normalization align cells. No true cell pairs required.
records.target: Shared/dataset-specific variation and cell identity across datasets/modalities.
records.theorem_applicability: Covered for independent disjoint assays with fixed allowed gene mappings and a broad causal class.
records.positive_restrictions: Common metagene structure and meaningful shared features can support state alignment; NMF constraints are not general causal restrictions.
records.evidence_locator: Figure 1; Methods: Performing iNMF Using Block Coordinate Descent, Equation 1.
records.caveat: This record concerns original LIGER, not later unshared-feature extensions. Regulatory-element nomination is not intervention identification.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: Multi-Omics Factor Analysis—a framework for unsupervised integration of multi-omics data sets
records.training_information: Multiple views measured on the same or partially overlapping identified samples. A common sample-factor matrix and view-specific loadings allow missing entries/views; feature identities need not match between views.
records.target: Major sources of variation, factor interpretation, clustering and missing-data imputation.
records.theorem_applicability: Native overlapping-sample use is outside strict-disjoint assumptions. Completely disconnected sample/view blocks require additional constraints; permitting missing values alone does not identify their joint.
records.positive_restrictions: A valid shared-factor model and enough linked observations support estimation of common factors.
records.evidence_locator: Results and Figure 1; Materials and Methods: model specification and missing values.
records.caveat: Shared factors and loadings describe variation, not directed causal effects. Original examples include bulk samples and paired single cells.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: MOFA+: a statistical framework for comprehensive integration of multi-modal single-cell data
records.training_information: Sample-indexed views plus known groups such as experiments/conditions. Shared view loadings and group-specific factor activities, sparse/ARD priors and missing-data handling extend MOFA. Different cell groups may be disjoint while modalities remain linked within observed samples.
records.target: Shared and group/view-specific variability, interpretable factors and scalable multimodal analysis.
records.theorem_applicability: Depends on observation pattern: paired/overlapping views are outside strict-disjoint contract. Disjoint experimental groups are not synonymous with unlinked modalities.
records.positive_restrictions: Connected observation patterns and correct factor/sparsity assumptions support joint estimation.
records.evidence_locator: Figure 1; Methods: model regularization and guidelines for groups/views.
records.caveat: Missing-view tolerance does not demonstrate identification for wholly disconnected modality blocks; no general regulatory-DAG theorem inferred.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: MultiVI: deep generative model for the integration of multimodal data
records.training_information: Jointly profiled RNA/ATAC cells plus optional RNA-only/ATAC-only cells and batch covariates. Modality encoders are aligned/averaged for paired observations, with observed-modality likelihoods and adversarial alignment. Additional protein modalities are supported.
records.target: Joint state representations, missing-modality imputation, uncertainty and differential analysis.
records.theorem_applicability: Published paired-assisted regime is outside strict-disjoint contract. A hypothetical all-disjoint, no-paired-pretraining mode remains subject to the theorem; the paper's 1–99% artificial unpairing is not proof for that setting.
records.positive_restrictions: Sufficient representative paired data and transportable decoder relationships can support prediction.
records.evidence_locator: Results: model, paired/unpaired integration; Methods: inference/training; official MultiVI model documentation.
records.caveat: Artificially unpaired cells appear in both assay lists; remaining cells are paired. This is not independent disjoint sampling. No all-unpaired guarantee claimed here.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: Joint probabilistic modeling of single-cell multi-omic data with totalVI
records.training_information: Same-cell RNA/protein counts from CITE-seq, with optional batch/donor covariates. Supports differing antibody panels and RNA-only batches in addition to jointly profiled training data.
records.target: Joint representation, protein-background correction, feature correlation estimation, integration and differential expression.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside strict-disjoint contract for its paired training regime, including subsequent unimodal queries.
records.positive_restrictions: Paired observation and appropriate count/background/batch models support estimating joint observational relationships.
records.evidence_locator: Results: The totalVI model; Methods: conditional joint distribution p(x_n,y_n|s_n), integration with missing proteins.
records.caveat: Useful explicit counterexample to 'integration never recovers relationships': paired-data correlation estimation is a stated task, but correlation is not causal orientation.

records.title: Cobolt: integrative analysis of multimodal single-cell sequencing data
records.training_information: Joint-modality cells provide the linkage between distinct feature spaces; optional separate RNA-only and ATAC-only datasets are integrated through the multimodal latent model and transfer correction. No peak-to-gene matching is required.
records.target: Shared cell representation, joint clustering and integration of multimodal/unimodal datasets.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside strict-disjoint contract in the demonstrated integration setup: jointly sequenced bridge cells are supplied.
records.positive_restrictions: Representative paired cells and transferable latent factors permit cross-view estimation.
records.evidence_locator: Results: The Cobolt model; Methods: hierarchical model and correcting missing modalities.
records.caveat: A missing-modality encoder is not evidence that training with no paired bridge identifies the same joint.

records.title: A deep generative model for multi-view profiling of single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data
records.training_information: RNA counts and TF-IDF-transformed ATAC profiles from the same cells. Joint encoder/decoder with Gaussian-mixture latent prior, attention modules and clustering-consistency constraints. The mixture component is inferred, not automatically an observed cell-type label.
records.target: Joint embedding, denoising/imputation, clustering, trajectories and cis-regulatory-element analysis.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside strict-disjoint contract: the joint observations and matched rows are inputs.
records.positive_restrictions: Same-cell data allow joint observational estimation subject to model/noise adequacy.
records.evidence_locator: Results: The scMVP model, Figure 1 and joint ELBO; Methods: multi-view model.
records.caveat: CRE identification and inferred cluster consistency do not alone establish direct causal direction. Do not describe this as an unpaired-only algorithm.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: A mixture-of-experts deep generative model for integrated analysis of single-cell multiomics data
records.training_information: Paired multimodal training observations. Each modality's encoder learns latent values that reconstruct all measured modalities through a mixture-of-experts posterior; trained encoders support unimodal cross-generation.
records.target: Interpretable latent representation, clustering and bidirectional missing-modality generation.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside strict-disjoint contract when trained as published on paired CITE-seq/SHARE-seq cells.
records.positive_restrictions: Learnable cross-view relationships and training coverage can support prediction on related cells.
records.evidence_locator: Figure 1; STAR Methods: ELBO for x_1:M and mixture-of-experts; training/test split descriptions.
records.caveat: Decoder traversals called regulatory programs are model feature associations; generating an unobserved modality does not identify intervention effects.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: BABEL enables cross-modality translation between multiomic profiles at single-cell resolution
records.training_information: Jointly profiled RNA/ATAC cells train interoperable modality encoders and decoders using within- and cross-modality reconstruction. Trained networks are applied to single-modality cells; additional protein translation is demonstrated.
records.target: Cross-modality prediction and hypothesis generation in related cell contexts.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside strict-disjoint contract: paired training supervision contributes joint information even when deployment queries are unimodal.
records.positive_restrictions: Transferability from sufficiently representative paired training examples and adequate predictive model.
records.evidence_locator: Results: design/training on jointly profiled cells; Methods: model architecture and training.
records.caveat: Cross-decoding predicts outcomes; it does not implement a biological intervention. Performance on new contexts does not remove distribution-shift assumptions.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: Cross-Linked Unified Embedding for cross-modality representation learning
records.training_information: Partially paired multimodal cells supervise self/cross encoders into modality-specific subspaces. Self/cross ELBOs, same-cell representation agreement and adversarial alignment enable missing-modality embeddings.
records.target: Comprehensive embeddings, cross-modality matching and prediction.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside strict-disjoint contract in its published supervised regime; true paired training is explicit.
records.positive_restrictions: Paired coverage and transferable cross-encoder mappings support correspondence estimation.
records.evidence_locator: NeurIPS paper Sections 3, 4.3–4.5; Introduction explicitly states paired multimodal supervision.
records.caveat: CLUE is distinct from unsupervised GLUE despite sharing a software package. Challenge matching accuracy is not causal-DAG identification.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: Joint variational autoencoders for multimodal imputation and embedding
records.training_information: Two modality matrices and optional user correspondence F, including known same-cell pairs. Joint VAEs aggregate corresponding latent values. Additional inferred correspondence is derived from within-assay geodesic distances; reconstruction, KL, combination and alignment losses are used.
records.target: Cross-modal embedding, phenotype prediction, imputation and feature attribution.
records.theorem_applicability: Known-pair F lies outside strict-disjoint contract. With only data-derived correspondence and independent disjoint cells, the theorem applies to general causal recovery.
records.positive_restrictions: True correspondence or a valid restrictive manifold/coupling assumption can improve recoverability.
records.caveat: SHAP feature importance is predictive, not an intervention effect. The paper primarily evaluates partial known correspondence; do not silently treat inferred F as observed pairs.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: Fast, sensitive and accurate integration of single-cell data with Harmony
records.training_information: A common low-dimensional feature embedding, normally PCA of shared expression features, and known batch/covariate labels. Soft diversity-aware clustering and local linear correction; spatial-expression example uses shared genes.
records.theorem_applicability: Primarily horizontal/common-feature comparator, not an estimator of a missing cross-assay joint. If repurposed on disjoint assays, derived corrections do not escape the theorem.
records.positive_restrictions: Adequate common representation and separable batch/biological effects support harmonization.
records.evidence_locator: Online Methods 1.1 and 1.4; Discussion: corrected coordinates and original expression retained.
records.caveat: Do not classify horizontal batch correction as failed cross-assay causal recovery. Optional labels/initial clusters must be disclosed.
records.discovery_note: Nominated boundary method, verified by targeted primary-source lookup; not necessarily retrieved within the capped central OpenAlex queries.

records.title: Paired single-cell multi-omics data integration with Mowgli
records.training_information: Every omics matrix has the same identified cell columns. Shared nonnegative cell factors and modality-specific loadings minimize entropic OT reconstruction plus entropy regularization; feature costs use within-modality cosine distances. No cell-type labels are required for the factorization.
records.target: Joint cell embedding, clustering and interpretable feature programs.
records.theorem_applicability: Outside the strict-disjoint contract: observed same-cell correspondence links the modalities.
records.positive_restrictions: Pairing provides joint information; low-dimensional nonnegative factors impose a representation model.
records.evidence_locator: Results: Mowgli a new tool, Eq. 1; Methods: Notations, Optimal transport, Mowgli; same cell columns and within-modality ground costs.
records.caveat: OT is a reconstruction loss here, not evidence that OT can identify arbitrary missing cell couplings or orient causal edges.

records.title: scMoMaT jointly performs single cell mosaic integration and multi-modal bio-marker detection
records.training_information: Shared cell-batch or feature entities connect observed matrices. If disconnected, annotation-derived pseudo-modalities connect them: binarized gene-body/upstream-2kb ATAC sums become pseudo-RNA; corresponding RNA counts become pseudo-protein. Matrix tri-factorization shares cell/feature factors and association components; clusters are inferred, then used for marker retraining.
records.target: Mosaic cell integration, clustering and cluster-specific multimodal biomarkers.
records.theorem_applicability: Mode-dependent: observed paired bridges add joint information; pseudo-modalities computed from strict-disjoint assays plus fixed annotation remain within the theorem.
records.positive_restrictions: Connected entity graph and shared low-rank factors support integration; generated feature proxies encode assumptions about modality correspondence.
records.evidence_locator: Framework Eqs. 1–3 and entity connectivity; Methods: Calculating pseudo-count matrices, Retraining procedure.
records.caveat: Pseudo-RNA is not a second measured assay. Marker importance and association matrices do not by themselves establish direct regulation.
